newsitem.title: DUBAI: Banks drive Oman stocks skywards in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Banks drive Oman stocks skywards in active trade.

text.p: Oman stocks clocked up almost six percent in the week to Wednesday in heavy trade with banking and investment shares leading the rise, the exchange said.
The index climbed to a 232.88 point end from 219.92 points a week ago, the Muscat Securities Market (MSM) said.
Turnover rose sharply, with value traded more than doubling in the week to 24.06 million rials ($64 million), from 11.45 million rials a week earlier.
Some 7.88 million shares changed hands in the week compared with a previous 4.785 million shares.
Of the 61 companies traded, 41 rose, 11 were steady and nine dropped.
Oman Securities Portfolio gained considerable ground, closing at 1.730 rials -- up 0.540 rials on the week.
Al Ahlia Portfolio closed at 5.630, climbing from last week's 4.960.
